systems.name: Flotation & attachments
systems.note: Clean-room study uses 100% procedural Schedule-40 PVC pontoon tubes and 8 stainless band-clamp saddles; source study retains the four stretched catalogue tubes.

systems.name: Pipe frame & mast
systems.note: 53 mm square-section perimeter rails, four corner cross-sockets, planar X-braced + diamond deck truss, and 0.14 m central square mast column.

systems.name: Braces, rigging & connectors
systems.note: Inner and outer diagonal mast stay sets with upper mast collar rings and inline Suncor-class 316-SS jaw-jaw turnbuckles.

systems.name: Bilge-pump propulsion
systems.note: Port and starboard submerged Rule 2000-class marine bilge thrusters with slotted strainers and aft 29 mm water-jet discharge nozzles.

systems.name: Intake, cavitation nozzle & separator
systems.note: Central priming pump, 300-psi deck feed pump, inline 4-port Venturi Eductor with 4.20-in 316-SS 7-bore Kinetic Cavitation Nozzle, and aft-starboard Pyrolizer-Separator / DAF drum.

systems.name: Solar, storage & controls
systems.note: Forward 2.066 × 0.519 m flexible marine monocrystalline PV array and sealed deck supercapacitor / LiFePO4 buffer module.

systems.name: Rotor & generator
systems.note: Three-wing cycloidal/J-profile Lenz-2 VAWT rotor on six radial spoke arms driving a sealed masthead PMG alternator.

cleanroom.name: Manatee · 100% clean-room parametric CAD
cleanroom.note: 100% original procedural CAD replacement (CERN-OHL-S-2.0 / CC-BY-SA-4.0) resolving sol0075. Includes all 7 systems and the inline 316-SS 7-bore Kinetic Cavitation Nozzle & 4-port Venturi Eductor.

kinetic-nozzle.name: 316-SS Kinetic Cavitation Nozzle & 4-Port Eductor
kinetic-nozzle.note: Parametric 3D engineering study from KineticNozzle1.DXF (4.20 in OD × 4.20 in, 7 bores on 0.73 in pitch circle), KineticNozzle5gpd.dxf (1.06 in 5-GPD cartridge), and Eductor_Pump_Cavitation_Nozzle_schematic.jpg (180° cutaway 4-port Venturi eductor with helical vortex streamlines).

turnbuckle.name: Turnbuckle & cable connection
turnbuckle.note: Bench study, not installed on the raft. Suncor 1/4 in jaw–jaw envelope, visible threads and pinned eye; generic anchor and cable termination. Connection type still needs confirmation.

bilge-pump.name: Large bilge pump · reference study
bilge-pump.note: Complete 2000 GPH-class pump envelope, not a chosen thruster. Inlet cage, sealed motor, open hose outlet and two leads. Awaiting actual pump identity and propulsion arrangement.

hose-joint.name: Hose, barb & band clamp

kn-disc-420.name: 4.20-in 316-SS 7-Bore Kinetic Cavitation Nozzle (KineticNozzle1.DXF)
kn-disc-420.description: Exact 3D realization of KineticNozzle1.DXF & KineticNozzle1BBB.JPG (labeled "306 S.S." / 316 stainless steel): 4.20 in (106.68 mm) OD × 4.20 in (106.68 mm) cylinder Boolean-drilled with the 7-bore tetrahedral vortex cluster around the 0.73 in (18.54 mm) pitch circle — one central 0.25 in (6.35 mm) bore, three outer 0.25 in primary bores at 90°/210°/330°, and three interstitial 0.16 in (4.06 mm) secondary bores.
kn-disc-420.connection: Seats inside the converging motive inlet of the 4-port Venturi Eductor; high-velocity jets generate collapsing vapour cavities downstream.

kn-disc-5gpd.name: 5-GPD 1.06-in 316-SS Kinetic Nozzle Cartridge (KineticNozzle5gpd.dxf)
kn-disc-5gpd.description: Exact 3D realization of KineticNozzle5gpd.dxf: 1.06 in (26.92 mm) OD × 1.06 in (26.92 mm) 316-SS bench/pilot 5-GPD cavitation cartridge with 0.20 in (5.08 mm) pitch circle, four 0.06 in (1.52 mm) primary bores, and three 0.04 in (1.02 mm) secondary bores, shown alongside the 4.20-in full-scale unit for 1:4 scale comparison.
kn-disc-5gpd.connection: Seats inside the converging motive inlet of the 4-port Venturi Eductor; high-velocity jets generate collapsing vapour cavities downstream.

kn-eductor-body.name: Cutaway 4-Port Venturi Eductor & Cavitation Mixing Chamber
kn-eductor-body.description: 180° cutaway engineering model of Rudy Behrens' 4-Port Venturi Eductor & Cavitation Nozzle schematic (Eductor_Pump_Cavitation_Nozzle_schematic.jpg). Shows the bottom flanged high-pressure motive feed inlet, the seated 316-SS multi-bore kinetic nozzle insert, the four angled low-pressure induction ports, the converging acoustic-cavitation mixing chamber, and the diverging Venturi discharge diffuser.
kn-eductor-body.connection: Motive jet exits the 316-SS nozzle at high velocity into the converging chamber, pulling secondary slurry through the four angled induction ports and collapsing cavitation microbubbles in the throat.

kn-vortex-guides.name: Helical Vortex Core & Acoustic Cavitation Shear Streamlines
kn-vortex-guides.description: Illustrative 3D flow-field geometry inside the cutaway mixing chamber: central helical vortex core (blue) generated by the tetrahedral 7-bore cluster, surrounded by three high-frequency acoustic-cavitation shear filaments (cyan) rising from the four induction ports into the Venturi throat.
kn-vortex-guides.connection: Visualizes the hydrodynamic shear and microbubble implosion zone that lyses algae cell walls and emulsifies/cracks heavy hydrocarbons.

tb-body.name: Turnbuckle barrel
tb-body.description: Closed barrel: nominal 3.50 in length and 0.38 in diameter, based on Suncor S0101-0007.
tb-body.connection: Opposed right- and left-hand 1/4 in UNC studs engage this barrel. Internal thread form is simplified.

tb-stud-upper.name: Upper threaded fork
tb-stud-upper.description: Nominal 1/4 in UNC stud and fork. Jaw opening and pin size from manufacturer; transition profiles are simplified.
tb-stud-upper.connection: Fork cheeks flank the eye; pin passes through all three. Operating pin span shown at 190 mm, within published open/closed range.

tb-pin-upper.name: Upper clevis pin & retaining ring
tb-pin-upper.description: Removable cross-pin through the fork and mating eye. Retaining ring is schematic; retention detail must match the selected product.
tb-pin-upper.connection: Pin carries the eye load; the threaded stud does not screw into the cable.

tb-stud-lower.name: Lower threaded fork
tb-stud-lower.description: Nominal 1/4 in UNC stud and fork. Jaw opening and pin size from manufacturer; transition profiles are simplified.
tb-stud-lower.connection: Fork cheeks flank the eye; pin passes through all three. Operating pin span shown at 190 mm, within published open/closed range.

tb-pin-lower.name: Lower clevis pin & retaining ring
tb-pin-lower.description: Removable cross-pin through the fork and mating eye. Retaining ring is schematic; retention detail must match the selected product.
tb-pin-lower.connection: Pin carries the eye load; the threaded stud does not screw into the cable.

tb-anchor.name: Anchor lug with pin hole
tb-anchor.description: A drilled 5 mm plate illustrates a mating anchor. Not identified on the Manatee.
tb-anchor.connection: Its base attachment and backing structure remain unresolved; this plate is not installed in the source model.

cable-thimble.name: Cable-eye thimble
cable-thimble.description: Protective thimble form at the upper clevis. Profile simplified.
cable-thimble.connection: Upper pin crosses the hollow eye. Actual thimble groove and wire diameter must be matched.

cable-eye.name: 1/8 in cable eye & tail
cable-eye.description: 1/8 in cable drawn as a smooth centreline envelope; strand construction is not reproduced.
cable-eye.connection: Return tail and standing run meet the eye. End termination type must be confirmed from the actual machine.

cable-sleeves.name: Example swage sleeves
cable-sleeves.description: Example swaged termination, not an assertion that the raft uses swages.
cable-sleeves.connection: Confirm swage versus clips versus a swageless fitting; hardware and tooling must match the cable.

pump-strainer.name: Removable slotted inlet strainer
pump-strainer.description: Slotted inlet cage and removable base, based on the form of a large marine bilge pump.
pump-strainer.connection: Water must reach the inlet slots. Mounting-hole locations and service-release mechanism are not specified.

pump-motor.name: Motor housing & lower wet chamber
pump-motor.description: Rule 2000 / 10-6UL reference class: 152 mm tall, 108 mm wide. This is a size study, not identification of the actual Manatee pump.
pump-motor.connection: Outlet opens into an illustrative lower wet chamber, separate from the upper motor envelope. Impeller and shaft seal are not reconstructed.

pump-discharge.name: Open discharge hose barb
pump-discharge.description: Nominal 1-1/8 in (29 mm) hose connection, using the manufacturer hose size. Barb profile/position are illustrative.
pump-discharge.connection: A complete pump pushes water through this outlet. A cartridge/propeller conversion would be a different assembly.

pump-leads.name: Sealed power-lead exit
pump-leads.description: Two insulated leads leave the housing. Lead gauge, gland geometry and circuit protection depend on the actual pump.
pump-leads.connection: Splices and disconnects belong outside the submerged connection zone unless specifically rated; exact route is pending.

hose.name: Hose with visible bore
hose.description: Short flexible hose at nominal 29 mm bore. Generic wall thickness.
hose.connection: This illustrates a joint only; no route or pressure rating is assigned to the raft.

hose-barb.name: Barbed spigot with open bore
hose-barb.description: Hose overlaps the ridged spigot. Mating bore is visible; wall profiles are illustrative.
hose-barb.connection: Barb OD fits inside the nominal hose bore, with local interference at the ridges. Exact fitting standard and material depend on the chosen pump.

hose-clamp.name: Worm-drive band, housing & screw
hose-clamp.description: Band sits over the hose above the inserted barb. Worm housing and screw are individually shaped.
hose-clamp.connection: Clamp type/count/torque must follow the selected hose and fitting. No high-pressure suitability is implied.

questions.text: What is the thruster pump make/model/GPH, and does it retain the complete pump housing or drive an exposed propeller?
Which stays are rigid metal braces and which are wire? Where do turnbuckles attach, and are their ends hook/eye/jaw?
What are the actual pontoon/frame outside diameters and socket fittings? Source part scales conflict with annotations.
Which solar panel, storage device and control enclosure belong on this version? The drawn PV slab is distorted catalogue geometry.
Confirm operating pressure and orifice wear tolerance for the 4.20-in vs 1.06-in 316-SS 7-bore Kinetic Cavitation Nozzle and 4-port Venturi Eductor.
How does the rotor shaft connect to the generator and bearing/mast assembly?
